# Address Resolution Protocol (ARP)

## 1. Protocol Overview
The Address Resolution Protocol (**ARP**) dynamically maps a 32-bit IPv4 network address to a 48-bit media access control (**MAC**) link-layer hardware address.

### Mathematical Model of Packet Header
$$\text{Total Length} = 28 \text{ bytes (Ethernet / IPv4)}$$

| Field | Length (Bytes) | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Hardware Type (HTYPE) | 2 | Typically Ethernet (`0x0001`) |
| Protocol Type (PTYPE) | 2 | Typically IPv4 (`0x0800`) |
| Hardware Address Length (HLEN) | 1 | `6` for IEEE 802.3 MAC |
| Protocol Address Length (PLEN) | 1 | `4` for IPv4 |
| Operation Code (OPER) | 2 | `1` for Request, `2` for Reply |

```text
+-----------------------+-----------------------+
| Hardware Type (16)    | Protocol Type (16)    |
+-----------------------+-----------------------+
| HLEN (8)  | PLEN (8)  | Operation Code (16)   |
+-----------------------+-----------------------+
```

- Detailed reference: [RFC 826](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc826)
